english:
Become <arc Amplified /> by reaching 100% activation progress with <arc Arc /> kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.

Progress per kill by <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File enemies: 25%
• Elites and Players: 50%
• Enemies of the Miniboss Tier or higher: 100%

<arc Amplified /> lasts 15 seconds and grants the following benefits:
• 50 Mobility
• 40 Handling with 5% decreased Handling Animation Duration
• Slide Distance increased to 8.5 meters
• Reduced accuracy of PvE Combatants targeting you
• 15% Damage Resistance against PvE Combatants

Sprinting for 2.5 seconds while <arc Amplified /> grants <arc Speed Booster />, maximizing Movement Speed, increasing Slide Distance to 11 meters, and granting 25% increased Jump Height and 15% Damage Resistance against PvE Combatants.

<arc Speed Booster /> lingers for 2 seconds after you stop sprinting and can persist after <arc Amplified /> expires.

Performing a <arc Speed Booster /> slide increases your base Slide Distance from 6.5 to 8.5 meters until death.

source.text:
Intrinsic Arc Subclass Buff
Obtained by reaching 100% Counter Progress through Arc Kills within 6 seconds of each, or through Aspects.
Rank-And-File = 25% | Elite = 50% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 50%

Amplified:
+50 Mobility, increases Slide Distance to 8.5 meters, +40 Handling, and 0.95x Handling Duration Multiplier for 15 seconds. 
Combatants are less accurate at targeting the wearer and grants 15% Damage Resist against Combatants while active.
While Amplified, sprinting for 2.5 seconds grants Speed Booster.

Speed Booster:
Maximizes Movement Speed, increased Slide Distance to 11 meters, 25% Increased Jump Height, and 15% Damage Resist against Combatants.
Speed Booster lingers for 2 seconds until no longer sprinting, even after Amplified runs out.
Performing a Speed Booster Slide permanently increases base Slide Distance from 6.5 meters to 8.5 meters until death.
